The '''Trade and Traffic Ministry''' was an organization led by the individual [[Blissa Vlix]] that operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wroona/Legends|Wroona]]. At some point during [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] history, a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] group attacked a number of [[Starship/Legends|starships]] along [[Keller's Void/Legends|Keller's Void]], a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] that linked Wroona and the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Calus]], and Vlix subsequently announced that the Trade and Traffic Ministry suspected that the pirates were former [[Mining/Legends|miners]] from the [[Udine system/Legends|Udine system]].
